hook: Stop soaking your wooden cutting board. Seriously.
doThis: Coarse salt and half a lemon.

steps.say: Wash with hot water and a drop of soap.
Sprinkle coarse salt, then scrub with half a lemon.
Rinse, then dry it standing upright.
Once a month, rub in food-safe mineral oil.

safety.say: Never soak it, no dishwasher, no bleach, never mix cleaners.
safety.text: No soaking. No dishwasher. No bleach.
